seoTitle: Programmatic & Audio Advertising for Local Business
description: Plain-English guidance on programmatic, display, Spotify, Pandora, and podcast ads for local small businesses, including costs, platforms, and when they fit.
intro: This guide brings together our articles on programmatic, display, and audio advertising for local businesses. It explains how automated ad buying works, what Spotify, Pandora, iHeart, and podcast ads can cost, and how these channels compare with search ads. It is for owners who keep hearing these terms from sales reps and want a straight explanation first.

With a limited budget, begin with the plain-English explainer on programmatic advertising, then the comparison of display and programmatic. If you are curious about audio, read the Spotify cost and minimum budget articles before anything else. Most small businesses should have Google Business Profile and basic search ads working first, because these channels build awareness rather than catching people ready to buy.

Spotify Ad Studio and Google Display can be set up by an owner with an afternoon and a small test budget. Full programmatic platforms, TV, and DSPs usually carry minimums and a learning curve that suit larger budgets. If you are unsure whether a proposal is fair, DataLatte can review it with you and tell you honestly if it is worth it.

faq.q: What is programmatic advertising in simple terms?
faq.a: It is the automated buying of ad space across websites, apps, streaming audio, and video, usually using targeting such as location or interests. A platform does the buying in real time instead of a person negotiating each placement. Our plain-English guide explains the parts involved.

faq.q: How much do Spotify ads cost for a local business?
faq.a: Spotify Ad Studio lets advertisers set their own budget, but there is a minimum, and pricing changes over time. Check current figures in the platform before planning. Our cost and minimum budget articles explain what to expect and how to think about it.

faq.q: Is programmatic advertising worth it for a small business?
faq.a: Sometimes. It can help with awareness and retargeting in a defined local area, but it rarely replaces search ads or a strong Google Business Profile. Test with a small budget and a clear goal, such as store visits or calls, and be cautious of large minimum commitments.

faq.q: What is the difference between display and programmatic ads?
faq.a: Display ads are the banner and image formats you see on websites. Programmatic describes how ads are bought, automatically and often across many channels. Display can be bought programmatically, which is why the terms overlap. Our comparison article lays out when each fits.
